features.text: Allow and Block bouquets, plus your own custom groups and categories in aliases and bouquets
Opt-in live normalization so players don't freeze when a stream fails over, with CPU, VAAPI or Intel Quick Sync encoding (requires M3U Proxy v0.4.37+)
Opt-in PostgreSQL 18 upgrade for the embedded database, with rollback support
Limit Auto-Add to Custom Playlist rules to specific channels or channel name patterns
Category Auto Sort keeps series categories in the provider's order, and Group Auto Sort now follows it on Xtream playlists
Choose which Sonarr or Radarr instance a request goes to from Discover, and set a default integration for automatic caching
Plugin settings fields can be shown conditionally
Series and categories the provider no longer lists are cleaned up on sync, and sync logs include added and removed categories
The backup client now matches your Postgres version
Optional isolated rate limits for proxy callbacks
Clearer managed-library controls for library publishing
Shared standard playlists can be picked when assigning Playlist Auths
Xtream VOD endpoint returns your custom names and titles, and content requests include more metadata

fixes.text: SSO (OIDC) sign-in no longer links an account already linked to a different SSO identity
Asset uploads only accept raster images, SVG is rejected
Provider-supplied EPG text is escaped in guide tooltips
Auto-enable follows groups the provider renames mid-sync
Sync runs finish after feed connection failures
Live streams and movies that share a provider stream ID are kept separate
Xtream live/VOD numbering matches M3U and XMLTV, and CSV imports go to the right live or VOD list
Auto-Add sync no longer removes channels you added by hand
A failed scheduled backup is no longer reported as created
Values of "0" are no longer treated as empty, including a Custom Password of "0"
Channel names match across non-ASCII case
Find & Replace keeps empty and "0" replacement values
Parallel channel scrubber batches complete
EPG mapping, timezone and logo proxy fixes, and timezones for numeric timeshift timestamps
Manual TMDB search for TV shows, overwrite-metadata keeping a known TMDB ID, and the Missing/Has TMDB filters
VOD metadata sync no longer reports success on failure, plus STRM filename and cleanup fixes
Unicode movie names from WebDAV and Add Progress duration clamping
Retention, retry and scheduling, any-channel rules and dvr:enrich --all
Network pin overlap and schedule regeneration
Dispatcharr, Sonarr and Post Processing fixes, and Dispatcharr profiles for an alias of a Custom Playlist
Managed-library path collisions and status
Scheduled backups, navigation settings, queue and SMTP settings
Queue Monitor retries no longer report false success, and impossible cron expressions are rejected
Nginx routing and Compose proxy health checks
Bouquet name uniqueness and merged-group checks in the Group API
System Health CPU count respects a narrower cpuset
Pending tool calls no longer show as successful
Update reporting, with a warning when an updated plugin may still be running old code
TV device sign-in respects the advertised polling interval
Playlist group, sort and copy-attributes tools, Copilot DVR search, guest filmography and the zh_CN translation
